aftercare.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate and a Base Labs affiliate, Tattoo Art Customs earns from qualifying purchases made through the links on this page.
aftercare.first48_1: Leave the initial wrap on for the time your artist tells you (usually 2–24 hours).
aftercare.first48_2: Wash gently with lukewarm water and fragrance-free soap. Pat dry — never rub.
aftercare.first48_3: Apply a thin layer of aftercare balm or ointment. Thin is key: too much suffocates the skin.
aftercare.first48_4: Keep it clean, keep it moisturized, and keep it out of the sun.
aftercare.p1_desc: Transparent adhesive wrap that protects your fresh tattoo for days — shower with it on, heal faster, less scabbing. The large pack covers bigger pieces.
aftercare.p2_desc: The industry-standard tattoo balm — vegan, petroleum-free, safe for fresh ink and great for keeping healed tattoos vibrant. A tub lasts a long time.
aftercare.p3_desc: The classic. Dermatologist-recommended, fragrance-free, and cheap — a thin layer keeps fresh tattoos protected and moisturized through the peel.
aftercare.p4_desc: Aftercare made for tattooed skin — built to soothe fresh ink and keep it healing clean. Our link applies the TAC20 discount automatically.
aftercare.recommend_sub: These are the products artists actually use. Buying through these links supports Tattoo Art Customs at no extra cost to you.
aftercare.sub: Heal it right and your ink stays bold for decades. Here's the routine real artists swear by.
aftercare.title: Tattoo Aftercare Guide
aftercare.weeks_1: Moisturize 2–3 times a day as the tattoo peels and flakes. Don't pick the flakes.
aftercare.weeks_2: No soaking — showers only, no baths, pools, or hot tubs for at least 2 weeks.
aftercare.weeks_3: No direct sun on the fresh tattoo. After it's healed, sunscreen keeps the colors from fading.
